summary: WP-P3 Operator Journey and Production Release implementation handoff, scoped only to semprod-wp-operator-release. Compose the accepted WP-P1 persistence/backfill and WP-P2 retrieval/readiness public boundaries into an operator-safe fresh-project sequence: argo init, canonical structural projection, SemanticIndexPending, explicit or approved opted-in semantic backfill, explicit readiness verification, then semantic query. Both successful fixtures use equivalent approved external configuration and differ only by automatic-backfill opt-in. Missing, unsafe, and unapproved opted-in configuration must stop before automatic-start/backfill/provider/database effects with redacted actionable errors. Canonical JSON authority, exact no-argument snapshots, graph-tidy behavior, external credential boundaries, WP-P1/WP-P2 internals, and runner-owned deliveryStatus remain frozen. This stage-owned artifact explicitly supersedes the tracked WP-P2 temporary handoff because WP-P2 is accepted at commit 56cfad2 and WP-P3 is the authorized sequential package; it does not revise or reopen WP-P2 behavior.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Run two controlled fresh-project journeys through the production semantic operator command adapter and composition boundary. Both receive equivalent approved externally supplied Neo4j and embedding-provider configuration and differ only by automaticBackfillOptIn. Exercise argo init, canonical structural projection, pre-ready query, explicit or automatic backfill, progress/checkpoint/isolated-failure/resume evidence, explicit readiness verification, aligned semantic query, and no-argument snapshots. Also run opted-in missing, unsafe, and unapproved configuration controls.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: No opt-in reports actionable SemanticIndexPending, performs zero automatic start, exposes explicit backfill/readiness/query commands, blocks pre-ready query without snapshot fallback, surfaces controlled progress/checkpoint/failure/resume evidence, then queries only after Aligned verification. Approved opt-in validates configuration before exactly one automatic start and follows the same readiness-before-query gate. Every rejected opt-in has zero automatic-start, explicit-backfill, provider, and database effects, returns redacted actionable guidance, preserves the exact no-argument snapshot, and leaks neither credential values nor unsafe source contents. Both successful paths leave canonical JSON byte-identical and preserve accepted WP-P1/WP-P2 behavior.
